pr_body:
This adds loggign for the *QL pluggins.

Exceptions resulting in a 5xx-class responses are logged on `WARN` level, otherwise `DEBUG`.

Fixes #100801, #100802.
pr_comments: Hi @bpintea, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

> if the query failed or not 

The logging only occurs on failure. Removed now the prefixes too, will let the class name that the logger adds be the indicator of failing query type.

issue_context.title: EQL: log returned exceptions
issue_context.body:
### Description

We need to make sure we capture the exceptions leading to a non-successful response to the user. 
These should capture any other wrapped exceptions. 
Depending on the cause, they should be log warnings or errors.

review_comments: 👍 on making sure the errors are reported as coming from the SearchAction and NOT from a wrapping listener.
